request: Fix src/retry.py run(payload). max_attempts is a positive integer including the first attempt. Return attempts numbered 1 through max_attempts and delays: zero for the first attempt, then delay_seconds for every retry. Preserve delay_seconds; do not sleep. Preserve all public interfaces stated here. Python entrypoint is src.retry.run(payload). Inputs are JSON objects; return only plain JSON-compatible values (no Decimal objects, sets or tuples). Use only the standard library. Visible test tools check syntax only; functional verification is external.
title: Stop retries at the configured maximum
